cc:Work.dc:title: figure5_task_specific_measurement_priorities
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 5. Task-specific measurement priorities on a CFRP specimen. (a) Hash-verified initial reconstruction of specimen c8-2; teal marks the registered measured positions. (b,c) Retrospective CAI-mechanical and normalized-RGB-reconstruction oracle priorities on the same initial state and 8x8 action grid; white outlines mark the five highest-priority cells. (d) Paired within-map percentile difference, with red favoring CAI priority and blue favoring reconstruction priority. Across all six domains, the CAI contrast is 0.04862 (95% CI 0.04527-0.05205) and the registered normalized-RGB-MSE contrast is 5.503e-4 (95% CI 5.006e-4-6.063e-4). These panels visualize retrospective oracle opportunity, not learned-policy performance.
